t.p: To complete the installation, you need to restart your computer or log out. Either option will close all running applications.
After restarting or logging back in, open the Assistant again to continue setup.
To help the Assistant automatically suggest your timesheet entries, your browser needs to be able to communicate with your local ActivityWatch server.

ul.li: Click Open Settings below to open the ActivityWatch website.
Under Server settings, enter your Odoo database URL in the CORS Origins field.

div.class: d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center gap-2 bg-100 border rounded p-3 mb-4 fs-5

div.p: If you use the ActivityWatch Firefox extension, follow these steps to allow it to connect and track your activity.

ol.li:
Open the Firefox extensions page:
about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox

Find the ActivityWatch extension and copy its Manifest URL
moz-extension://abcd1234/manifest.json (example)
Open the ActivityWatch settings and paste the Manifest URL into the CORS Regex field.

Remove /manifest.json from the URL so it looks like this:
moz-extension://abcd1234 (example)

t.p: Click the Odoo icon in your system tray (usually in the top bar or bottom right of your screen), then restart the server.
